policies.privacy_rule: NEVER ask customers to tweet serial numbers, IMEI, Account ID email, passwords, or order numbers publicly. ALWAYS escalate to private DM.
policies.hardware_safety_rule: Any report of battery swelling, thermal runaway, smoke, or screen lifting must be immediately escalated to human safety tier with urgent Genius Bar inspection.
policies.billing_rule: Never promise or issue refunds on public Twitter. Direct customers to company.com/billing or DM for account verification.
policies.tone_guidelines: Empathetic, clear, professional. Acknowledge frustration, ask diagnostic questions (device model, OS version, steps tried), avoid blaming the customer.

software_os.name: Software & Operating System
software_os.description: Issues related to OS/macOS updates, battery drain after update, app crashes, freezing, and boot loops.
diagnostic_questions: Which model do you have and what OS version is currently installed in Settings > General > About?
Did this issue begin immediately after a recent update?
Have you tried force restarting your device since this began?
troubleshooting_steps: Force restart your device: press and quickly release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then hold the Side button until the Company logo appears.
Check for pending app updates in App Store > Profile > Update All.
Review Battery Usage in Settings > Battery to see which apps are consuming power.
Ensure sufficient free storage under Settings > General > device Storage.
escalation_conditions: Issue persists after reboot and settings reset
Customer reports device stuck in infinite boot loop or bricked

hardware_defect.name: Hardware & Physical Defects
hardware_defect.description: Physical damage, cracked screen, swollen battery, speaker distortion, microphone failure, charging port issues.
diagnostic_questions: Is there any physical damage or liquid contact with the device?
Does the battery or enclosure show any visible bulging or screen separation?
troubleshooting_steps: Inspect the charging port for lint or debris using a flashlight.
Test audio across multiple apps and inspect speaker grilles.
Check Battery Health in Settings > Battery > Battery Health.
escalation_conditions: Cracked screen requiring Genius Bar booking

account_security.name: Account ID & Account Security
account_security.description: Forgotten Account ID password, locked account, Two-Factor Authentication issues, activation lock, iCloud access.
diagnostic_questions: Are you seeing an error stating your Account ID has been locked for security reasons?
Do you have access to a trusted phone number or device?
troubleshooting_steps: Reset your password securely at https://company.com/forgot
Follow account recovery steps at https://company.com/support/HT204915
Ensure your trusted devices are connected to Wi-Fi to receive verification codes.
escalation_conditions: Account locked and customer unable to pass automated self-service recovery
Suspicion of account compromise / unauthorized access

billing_subscription.name: Billing, App Store & Subscriptions
billing_subscription.description: Unexpected charges, duplicate billing, in-app purchases, subscription management, refund requests.
diagnostic_questions: Does the charge appear in your Purchase History at https://company.com/billing?
Is this an active recurring subscription or a one-time purchase?
troubleshooting_steps: View and cancel subscriptions in Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions.
Review purchase history and request refunds at https://company.com/billing
Check if Family Sharing members made the purchase.
escalation_conditions: Customer requests refund or disputes credit card charge
Unrecognized fraud or continuous unauthorized charges

connectivity_features.name: Connectivity & Feature How-To
connectivity_features.description: Wi-Fi dropping, Bluetooth accessories failing to pair, AirDrop discovery, cellular service issues, CarPlay.
diagnostic_questions: Does this happen with all Wi-Fi networks/Bluetooth devices or only one specific accessory?
Have you tried toggling Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds and off?
troubleshooting_steps: Toggle Airplane Mode on for 30 seconds, then off.
Forget Wi-Fi network and reconnect in Settings > Wi-Fi.
Reset Network Settings in Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings.
Ensure AirDrop receiving is set to 'Everyone' or 'Contacts Only' in Control Center.
escalation_conditions: Hardware cellular modem failure ('No Service' hardware recall)

general_feedback.name: General Feedback & Rants
general_feedback.description: User venting frustration, product feedback, sarcastic remarks, brand commentary without actionable defect.
troubleshooting_steps: Provide the official Company feedback portal link: https://www.company.com/feedback
escalation_conditions: Customer threatens brand PR crisis or requests senior management escalation
